source: Chapter titles of freeCodeCamp.org's 'SQL Tutorial - Full Database Course for Beginners' (HXV3zeQKqGY); summaries hand-written in the style of generated lesson notes (#23).

lessons.title: What is a Database?
lessons.summary: Defines a database as any collection of related information, compares storing data on paper and on computers, and introduces database management systems.

lessons.title: Tables & Keys
lessons.summary: Explains how relational databases store data in tables of rows and columns, and how primary keys, foreign keys and composite keys identify and link rows.

lessons.title: SQL Basics
lessons.summary: Introduces SQL as the language for talking to relational database management systems, and its parts: queries, data definition, data manipulation and data control.

lessons.title: MySQL Windows Installation
lessons.summary: Step-by-step installation of the MySQL server and command-line client on Windows, and creating a first database.

lessons.title: MySQL Mac Installation
lessons.summary: Installing MySQL on macOS, setting the root password, and connecting from the terminal.

lessons.title: Creating Tables
lessons.summary: Uses CREATE TABLE with data types such as INT, VARCHAR and DATE, defines a primary key, and changes tables with ALTER TABLE and DROP TABLE.

lessons.title: Inserting Data
lessons.summary: Adds rows with INSERT INTO, including inserting into specific columns and handling NULL values.

lessons.title: Joins
lessons.summary: Combines rows from several tables with INNER JOIN, LEFT JOIN and RIGHT JOIN using related columns.

lessons.title: Nested Queries
lessons.summary: Uses the result of one SELECT inside another to answer questions that need several steps.

lessons.title: ER Diagrams Intro
lessons.summary: Introduces entity relationship diagrams: entities, attributes, relationships and cardinality, for designing a database schema before building it.
